hypothesis: A trained continuous neural memory residual can produce correctly attributed answers that follow changed source memories in unseen synthetic worlds, without retrieval prompts or a trained backbone.
scope: Oracle-event generation component only. Not automatic writing, learned multi-event activation, C serving or full memory accuracy.
approval_scope: The approved first 50 steps completed and failed fixed-panel C generation with independent review. Ordinary-chat correctness regressed from 2/4 to 0/4; grounded recall remained 0/8. Do not continue this candidate or deploy it. Diagnose objective/branch/read-decision issues before registering any new bounded training. The retained launch command is historical execution evidence, not approval.
numerical_preflight_scope: Three untrained diagnostic cases only; not state calibration, memory accuracy or complete free-response acceptance.
prerequisites: Complete applicable P1 input, provenance, data and scoring contracts without changing PLAN.md stage gates
Certify a fresh-prefix native free-generation backend including EOS, UTF-8, disabled and empty conditions
Freeze new train/dev worlds and all causal pairs before any optimizer step; old smoke and DG cases are not independent acceptance data
Complete actual independent scoring calibration; software fixtures alone do not qualify
Bind GGUF, encoder, tokenizer, source snapshot, dataset and training command hashes
Record no-memory baseline and separate teacher-forced diagnostics from free-generation outcomes
Qualify the corrected v2 prompt with the continuous branch; DG-004 legacy-template evidence is not a v2 certificate
Implement and validate the planned neural availability/task path for missing evidence; empty content bypass alone cannot learn abstention with a frozen backbone
selection: No selection on LoCoMo or independent final test. Predeclare development selection and checks before launch; do not select by NLL alone.
required_outcomes: Free-generated complete replies and joint subject/value/time/status correctness
Both sides of same-question value-swap and current-update pairs correct
Removed, empty, irrelevant, wrong-subject/relation and non-actual source conditions scored for unsupported certainty
Distractor/order and same-value-other-subject controls preserve attribution
Generation closure: max-length/EOS/UTF-8 and no-KV audit
NLL and target-token rank reported separately from paired semantic outcomes
scoring_calibration_scope: Two isolated model reviewers on 16 authored fixtures; same model family, not human validation or measured model answers. User authorized selecting the reviewers.

loss.generation: mean cross entropy per complete reply including EOS; prompt excluded
loss.batch_reduction: sum weighted per-example losses divided by actual batch size times corpus mean sample weight 1.5
loss.sampling: uniform rows, no additional state resampling

evaluation_schedule.teacher_forced_and_state: all 256 development rows; not generation accuracy
evaluation_schedule.free_generation_panel: first two sorted dev world IDs, both languages, original/swapped_values/empty/ordinary_original: fixed 16 rows
evaluation_schedule.early_stop: Do not progress beyond step 200 if no paired semantic improvement over step 0 or if ordinary-chat correctness degrades on the fixed panel; preserve all incomplete reviews and outputs. If reviews are incomplete, pause expansion rather than infer a pass.
evaluation_schedule.formal_acceptance: Unchanged PLAN.md stage gates; this pilot panel cannot establish them

launch_rule: Allow only the validated 50-step interval bound to CG-001-launch.json. Recheck CUDA/source/features/baseline before optimization; stop at 50 for actual C generation and review. EP-001 draft interlock remains unchanged.
promotion_rule: A pilot is not stage acceptance. Apply unchanged P2B and later P2C gates from PLAN.md; learned recall must replace oracle activation before system claims.
failure_action: Retain all checkpoints, generated texts and missing/unreviewed cases. Stop at the step cap; diagnose failure rather than increasing data/steps or relaxing acceptance thresholds.
